label: input h (or b) early-to-mid in the original phase (steps 2-6)
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, never at t<2, on the delimiter, or during copying, and almost entirely at steps 3-5 (steps 2 and 6 are weak). Token-selective: input h holds 65% of activation mass (18x lift), b 24%, digit 3 8%, e 2%, q a trace; other tokens essentially never. The strongest activations are h at step 3-4, especially after q and in sequences starting with r/o (e.g. r t k q [h]). Repeats of a token already seen fire much less (in_first=1 covers 91% of mass). Precision tops out near 0.5: about half of the h/b inputs at these positions stay below threshold, depending on preceding context that no simple variable captures. Dev: P 0.49, R 0.81, F1 0.61, mass recall 0.88.
